label: Acceptance gates
subgoals: List the conjunctive gates a candidate must pass
Reject a candidate that fails any single gate
Compute the gates with independent tools rather than the router's estimate

label: Signal-integrity gates
subgoals: Extract critical nets for SI simulation
Compare simulated impedance and loss against tolerance bands
Use fast solvers in the loop and full-wave models for finalists

label: Differential tests on reference designs
subgoals: Route the reference design with the baseline and the change
Diff per-net delay, length and via count
Flag nets outside the intended group that moved beyond tolerance
